item.title: Water Minister Matthew Samuda to participate in Atlantic Council’s U.S. – Caribbean Airtime and Ports Forum

item.title: Trans-Jamaican Highway in talks with Toll Authority on compensation after hurricane Melissa toll suspension last year
item.description: Trans-Jamaican Highway Limited (TJH) says it is in discussions with the Toll Authority as it seeks compensation following the suspension of tolls before and after the passage of Hurricane Melissa last year. In its unaudited financial statements for the fourth quarter ended December 2025, TJH outlined that the suspension resulted in direct toll losses amounting to approximately US$3,500,000.
